verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents connecting Gmail or Outlook so customer emails log automatically against the right contact and deal, and lists both as integrations. Two-way sync is never documented: nothing shows CRM-side changes or sends syncing back to the mailbox. Missing for 10: explicit two-way sync documentation, details on how matching to records works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records

citations.quote: Connect Gmail or Outlook so every customer email is logged against the right contact and deal automatically, with tracking and templates.
Connects with Gmail, Outlook, QuickBooks, Mailchimp, Apollo, Zapier, and more
